subject: SIG Questionnaire: initial intake & owner checklist
messages:
From: Lisa Monroe <lisa.monroe@acmecorp.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com
Cc: sig-requests@acmecorp.com
Date: 2026-10-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG request: Acme initial intake

Hi Olga,

Thanks for taking this — Acme is starting a SIG review for FY27 vendor risk and we'd like to request Redwood's completed SIG v1.0. I've attached our Acme_SIG_v1.xlsx (master questionnaire) and marked the sections where we need evidence or attachments. We typically ask for a completed questionnaire plus a short evidence index for the attestation artifacts.

Key constraints: deadline Oct 15 for the first-pass answers; final evidence by Oct 30. Can you confirm who on your side will own the different sections (networking, identity & access, data protection, operations, SDLC)? If you prefer, we can split the spreadsheet and accept a per-section delivery.

Questions from our risk team: a) do you have a centralized evidence index (preferred Drive link) and b) can you provide SOC 2 in-scope systems list? Not urgent in the first reply but good to know.

Attachments:
- ACME_SIG_v1.xlsx (questionnaire)

Thanks,
Lisa Monroe
Senior Security Program Manager
Acme Corp

- Data Protection & Encryption: Olga Petrov (olga.petrov@redwood.com)
- Operations & Incident Mgmt: Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwood.com)
- SDLC / Change Mgmt: Dev Patel (shared)

Action items (internal):
- Dev: extract infra answers and attach architecture diagram (if available)
- Rishi: produce a short list of IAM policies and SSO config doc references
- Marissa: prepare runbook excerpts for incident escalation and recent MTTR metrics
- Olga: collate encryption-at-rest/in-transit evidence and SOC 2 systems list

- evidence_index_template.md (starter)

- MTTR: a 12-month breakdown is preferred but a quarterly rollout is acceptable for the first pass.
